veranderings.voor: Ander flesse se lang nek, gebuig soos 'n swaan s'n, het lug ingelaat en die stoffies vasgevang.
veranderings.na: By ander flesse was die lang nek gebuig soos 'n swaan s'n. Die nek het lug ingelaat en die stoffies vasgevang.
veranderings.rede: The possessive with a parenthetical participle is wooden for Grade 6; two short sentences mirror the preceding 'By party flesse' and keep the meaning.

veranderings.voor: Daar het dieselfde vloeistof skoon gebly.
veranderings.na: In dié flesse het dieselfde vloeistof skoon gebly.
veranderings.rede: 'Daar' has no clear place to point back to after a sentence about the neck; naming the flasks makes the reference unambiguous.

veranderings.voor: Daarna hou die melk langer en is dit veiliger om te drink.
veranderings.na: Daarna hou die melk langer, en is dit veiliger om te drink.
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses that each have their own subject and verb (die melk hou; dit is), so a comma goes before it.
